title: What's New in QuickBar Pro v1.0.2
changelog:
🚀 New Features

- Smart Search: Find tools, presets, and templates instantly with fuzzy matching
- Auto-Save: Automatic project backup every 5 minutes with version history
- Multi-Language Support: Added Hindi, Spanish, and Japanese language packs
- Dark Mode Toggle: Switch between light and dark themes in settings

🛠️ Improvements

- 50% faster startup time with optimized asset loading
- Smoother canvas rendering at 60fps on all screen sizes
- Redesigned settings panel with grouped categories
- Better error messages with actionable suggestions
- Improved memory usage for large project files

🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed crash when importing large PNG files over 10MB
- Fixed undo/redo stack not clearing on new project
- Fixed export timeline not respecting custom frame rates
- Fixed preset search returning incorrect results
- Fixed tooltip positioning on multi-monitor setups

➕ Removed

- Legacy import wizard replaced with drag-and-drop
- Deprecated API endpoints cleaned up
